notes: The UK has no short-term/long-term distinction — the same rates apply however long you held the asset.
Rates shown (18%/24%) apply to disposals on or after 30 October 2024. Earlier 2024–25 disposals used 10%/20% for most assets.
Enter your taxable income from other sources to determine how much of the basic-rate band remains.
Business Asset Disposal Relief is not modelled in this version.
